title: update_note
description: Update an existing note in the session's notes panel. Use the note_id prefix shown in [SESSION_NOTES] context to identify the note. You can update the content, pin/unpin, or both.

note_id.description: The note ID or its 8-character prefix from [SESSION_NOTES] context.

content.description: New content for the note. Supports full markdown formatting. Omit to keep existing content.

is_pinned.description: Set to true to pin the note to the top, false to unpin.
